description: Deloitte is a leading global professional services network providing a comprehensive suite of audit, consulting, financial advisory, risk management, tax, and legal services. The firm specializes in large-scale digital transformation, AI integration, and operating model redesign for enterprise and government clients across 150+ countries.
business_model: Global professional services network operating via member firms providing project-based consulting and recurring audit/tax engagements.
pricing_model: Project-based fees and professional service retainers
financial_highlights: Global revenue of approximately US$70.5 billion for FY2025
Deloitte Digital healthcare revenue grew 5% to $790.6 million in 2025
Ranked No. 1 in Security Services by revenue in 2026 Gartner Market Share report
leadership: Mo Reynolds (Chief People Officer, Deloitte U.S.)
value_proposition: Combining deep domain business knowledge with advanced engineering and AI capabilities to help organizations navigate complexity and drive digital transformation at scale.
rfp_strengths: Unmatched global scale and resource capacity (470k+ professionals)
Multi-disciplinary integration (Audit, Tax, and Consulting under one brand)
Strong government and public sector track record
Deep industry-specific expertise in healthcare and financial services
Proven delivery of large-scale ERP and cloud modernization projects
rfp_weaknesses: High cost structure compared to boutique firms
Potential for 'culture debt' and organizational friction during rapid AI transitions
Recent reports of reducing pay rises and bonuses in specific regions (UK) indicating financial pressure in certain divisions
opportunities: Expansion of Agentic AI within the Deloitte Omnia platform
Growth in AI-powered agreement management and automated workflows
Modernization of talent architecture to move away from traditional pyramid consulting models
challenges: Disruption of the traditional consulting pyramid model by AI
Client pressure to 'rescope and restructure' to reduce spending during transformations
Managing workforce transitions during the 'modernization' of job titles and roles
recent_news: Launched Connected Agentic Intelligence in Deloitte Omnia (2026)
Acquired Vision.bi in Israel to expand AI and data capabilities (June 2026)
Announced modernization of U.S. job titles to alphanumeric levels (June 2026)
Partnered with Docusign on AI-powered agreement management study (April 2026)
